intro.title: Component Library Theming
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple component library with a theming system, allowing you to switch between light and dark visual modes. You'll learn how to use Vue's reactive state and computed properties to manage and apply theme data across multiple components. The main technologies involved are Vue's Composition API (ref, computed) and CSS custom properties for styling. By the end, you'll understand how to create a centralized theme that consistently updates your UI's appearance.
intro.usecase: Component theming is essential for maintaining consistent branding across large-scale applications like e-commerce platforms, where product cards, buttons, and modals must adapt to seasonal promotions or dark/light mode preferences. In enterprise dashboards, theming allows different departments to customize data visualization components—charts, tables, and panels—with distinct color schemes while preserving functionality. Developers use this pattern to build white-label SaaS products, enabling clients to apply custom brand colors and typography to UI kits without modifying core component logic.
